prompt: Some parents think that children should do extracurricular activities. Others think that this will give them pressure. Discuss both views and give your opinio
essay:
Numerous parents believe that their child needs to join extracurricular activities, as it is a good option to boost children's physical and brain development, as well as make them healthier, and improve their social skills. In contrast, others say that this choice may pressure the children because there are a lot of activities and parents' high expectations towards them. In my opinion, I think children still need to do those exercises, but at the same time, parents must control their expectations and not enforce their children too much.

On the one hand, extracurricular activities offer huge benefits for the children. To begin with, it will significantly stimulate children's physical and non-physical development. For instance, exercises like gymnastics and swimming have a good impact on developing their strong motoric skills. Furthermore, these workouts also make the kids become healthier, as it drives them to be more active. In addition, by joining that community, the children can improve their social capabilities, as they are going to meet new friends.

On the other hand, tons of activities as well as parents' high expectations can burden the children. Nowadays, parents usually set tight schedules for their kids, such as school, tutoring, and extracurricular activities from Monday to Sunday (from dusk till down). As a result, the children can get tired easily and lose interest in hobbies that they once liked. Moreover, when they try to communicate this, their parents often demand high commitment and discipline. Therefore, this situation can lead to high pressure for the children doing those tasks.

In conclusion, extracurricular clubs brings good impact for the children by boosting their physical and brain development, making them healthy, and improving their social abilities. However, it can overburden them when parents establish a tight weekly plan and set high expectations for their kids. So, I believe parents need to control their expectations and treat their kids nicely whenever they do not want to go. Explain smoothly and do not force the children if they do not want to join the club for the day.
